facts: Official public-charging page states Cogeser network Quick AC tariff 0.67 EUR/kWh VAT included, effective from 2025-10-01.
Cogeser electricity-bill customers may charge on Cogeser network at 0.49 EUR/kWh VAT included from 2025-10-01.

negativeOrLimitingEvidence: Current Cogeser communications also reference Fast Charge availability in 2026, while the public tariff table only proves the Quick Cogeser AC class.
Therefore 0.67 EUR/kWh cannot safely be generalized to all 60 CGS EVSE without an EVSE-to-class join.
investigations.nextUsefulStep: Join current CGS EVSE connector/power metadata to the proven Quick AC class; keep Fast/non-AC fail-closed until a current official direct tariff is found.

facts: Official Allego app page exposes country-specific Italy pricing as a distinct block.
Italy Allego Plus: Ultrafast 350 kW 0.55 EUR/kWh, Fast 150 kW 0.70 EUR/kWh, 9.99 EUR/month.
Italy Allego Smart: Ultrafast 350 kW 0.75 EUR/kWh, Fast 150 kW 0.70 EUR/kWh, free subscription in app.
Italy pay-as-you-go: Ultrafast 350 kW 0.81 EUR/kWh, Fast 150 kW 0.70 EUR/kWh, no app/card required.
All prices include VAT; overstay charges may apply.

negativeOrLimitingEvidence: The tariff classes are deterministic, but the canonical 28 EVSE still need a deterministic EVSE-to-Fast/Ultrafast mapping before rankable promotion.
No Regular class is shown for Italy in the current Allego country block, but this alone is not used to infer every canonical EVSE class.
investigations.nextUsefulStep: Join PUN/OCPI connector maximum power to Allego Italy Fast versus Ultrafast classes and validate threshold semantics from the current Allego metadata.
